paras: On Monday we posted that October was <r>$615M in the red</r> for US spot Bitcoin ETFs.
Then buyers came back: <g>over $1 billion</g> flowed in over three sessions, including about $525M on Wednesday alone, led by BlackRock and Fidelity.
The money came in, but the price didn't follow: Bitcoin <r>slipped back near $81.5K</r> on Thursday as US stocks fell.
Ether ETFs only just ended a <r>5-day outflow streak</r>, with a small $14.9M inflow.
<u>Flows show demand; they don't set the price on their own.</u>
